raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From batch 13 on, rows from a new, undocumented 'v2' collector have txn_ts values exactly 6 hours later than legacy local time, most likely UTC instead of local UTC-6. Legacy rows start at about 06:00 and v2 rows at about 12:00, so late-evening v2 transactions roll into 00:00-06:00 of the next day. That creates the false 2026-01-19 date bucket and the out-of-hours transactions on 2026-01-18. The fix shifts v2 timestamps back 6 hours; the offset is inferred from the data, not documented, so the source team should confirm v2 timestamp semantics.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
